# Internal Revenue Service (IRS)

> The IRS provides comprehensive federal tax filing, payment, refund tracking, and compliance resources for individuals, businesses, nonprofits, and international taxpayers.

The IRS website serves as the official U.S. government portal for tax administration, offering tools like Where's My Refund, IRS Free File, Your Account dashboard, and the Document Upload Tool. The site maintains multilingual support in Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Vietnamese, and Haitian Creole to serve diverse taxpayer populations.

## Key Topics

- IRS Free File
- Where's My Refund
- Your Account
- Form 1040
- EIN (Employer Identification Number)
- Tax Refunds
- Identity Protection
- FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act)
- ITIN
- Tax Withholding
- Amended Returns
- Tax Forms
- Taxpayer Assistance Center Locator
- Document Upload Tool
- Business Taxes

## Individual Tax Filing

- [Individual tax filing](https://www.irs.gov/individual-tax-filing): Form 1040 filing guide with deadlines, free options, and IP PIN info.
- [Your account](https://www.irs.gov/your-account): IRS account portal for managing personal, business, and tax pro accounts.
- [Let us help you](https://www.irs.gov/help/let-us-help-you): IRS help hub offering free tax assistance, tools, and local office finder.

## Business & Tax-Exempt Organizations

- [Businesses](https://www.irs.gov/businesses): Business tax resources including EIN, employment tax, and FATCA info.
- [Charities and nonprofits](https://www.irs.gov/charities-and-nonprofits): Tax-exempt organization guidance on Form 990 filing and status.

## International & Special Taxpayers

- [International taxpayers](https://www.irs.gov/individuals/international-taxpayers): International tax guidance for U.S. citizens abroad, FATCA, and ITIN.

## Multilingual Resources

- [Spanish language portal](https://www.irs.gov/es): IRS Spanish-language portal for tax filing and refund information.
- [Simplified Chinese portal](https://www.irs.gov/zh-hans): IRS Simplified Chinese portal for tax help and EIN applications.
- [Traditional Chinese portal](https://www.irs.gov/zh-hant): IRS Traditional Chinese portal for tax filing and identity protection.
- [Korean language portal](https://www.irs.gov/ko): IRS Korean-language portal for tax filing and refund status.
- [Russian language portal](https://www.irs.gov/ru): IRS Russian-language portal for tax payments and refund information.
- [Vietnamese language portal](https://www.irs.gov/vi): IRS Vietnamese-language portal for tax filing and withholding.
- [Haitian Creole portal](https://www.irs.gov/ht): IRS Haitian Creole portal for tax services and refund status.

## Home

- [IRS homepage](https://www.irs.gov): IRS homepage: Pay taxes, check refunds, find forms and tax help tools.
